title: Coding agent can rewrite the workflow that holds the production deploy key
narrative: An internal AI coding agent has a write_file tool whose repo:contents:write permission is scoped to ** (the whole repo).
That scope reaches .github/workflows/**, which is where build.yml lives.
build.yml runs with permissions: write-all on pull_request_target and consumes the PROD_DEPLOY_KEY secret.
No single one of these is alarming. The chain is: the agent can edit the file that holds the production key.
The fix is one scoped change: narrow repo:contents:write from ** to src/**. The path disappears; the agent can still write application code.
